data.name: Manta Ray Moonlight Snorkel in Keauhou - Kona
data.headline: LATER times are BETTER, more Rays & more time with them! The tour you pick is your check in time
data.description:
SWIM WITH GIANT MANTA RAYS – The #1 Bucket-List Adventure on the Big Island! 🌺✨

Imagine this: It’s pitch-black night on the Kona coast. You slip into the warm Pacific, grab onto your glowing light board, and suddenly massive 12–18 ft manta rays come soaring straight toward you, doing graceful dances below your mask. Their wide mouths scoop glowing plankton while their “eyes” lock onto yours in the spotlight. This isn’t a dream – it ONLY happens right here in Kailua-Kona, and it’s hands-down the most mind-blowing wildlife encounter on planet Earth!

Why you’ll be screaming “BEST NIGHT EVER!”

ONE OF THE ONLY PLACES ON EARTH you can snorkel with wild manta rays at night – National Geographic calls it a Top-5 “Thing to Do Before You Die”

Get CRAZY close (safely & respectfully) as these gentle, spot-covered giants feed, flip, and dance in a dazzling underwater light show.

Our custom light boards + monster 150,000-lumen lights turn the ocean into a natural manta ray theater – they literally come to YOU!

Easy, relaxing surface floating – just lie on your stomach, hold the board, float, and let the show unfold beneath you.

Pro guides right beside you the entire time, helping you stay perfectly positioned for the ultimate front-row view.

What to Expect:

A quick 3-minute cruise from the harbor drops you at the spot. You’ll swim ~25 feet to our floating “superman” light array, clip on a comfy ankle flotation belt (keeps you flat and effortless on the surface), and then… the mantas arrive for an unforgettable ballet.

⚠️ HEADS UP – this is the REAL ocean adventure!
You MUST be a confident swimmer and comfortable putting your face in the water (even in the dark). Not for total beginners unless you’re a strong, independent swimmer who loves adventure. If you’re ready for pure magic, this is it!
Join the few who call this “the single coolest thing I’ve ever done in my life.”

Spaces are limited – these gentle giants are waiting to meet YOU!

Let’s make memories that will give you goosebumps for years. See you under the stars! 🌊🌟

Mahalo and ALOHA!
data.highlights:
Manta Ray Night Snorkel – Get Ready for the Show of a Lifetime! 🔥

Blast off on a heart-pounding 3-minute boat ride straight to the world’s #1 manta ray hotspot!

Night tours = STATISTICALLY EPIC sightings – more giant mantas, more barrel rolls, more magic!

Ultra-exclusive: ONLY 17 adventurers per trip – this is YOUR front-row seat to the ocean’s greatest ballet!

We unleash a jaw-dropping 300,000+ lumens of brilliant white + UV purple light – turning the sea into a glowing underwater stage that draws mantas like moths to a flame!

ZERO RISK, ALL REWARD: No mantas? Come back FREE on us (subject to availability)!

Direct bookers get the legendary Manta Guarantee built right in – at no extra charge!

These graceful, 12-17 foot-wingspan giants will cartwheel inches from your mask – it’s pure ocean adrenaline!
Mahalo… now let’s go dance with the mantas! 🌊✨
data.itinerary:
1: You will check in at the van with the host at expected time 

2: Host will brief at the van and send group down when ready

3: Group will wait for instruction from the crew who will meet at the light pole by the boat ramps (as said on van or instructions from host)

4: Group will load and be given a safety briefing on step by step what to do  during the 3 minute boat ride (Please listen carefully and respectfully) 

5: Once light board and swim guide are situated, the captain will say when it is time to go into water

6: In the water you will have approximately 30 minutes with these beautiful ocean butterflies depending on how good the show is 

(Please keep in mind they are federally and internationally protected, DO NOT TOUCH)

7: Once tour is over you will be instructed how to board and brought back into the harbor

****CHECK IN ADDRESS:

78-7100 Kaleiopapa st.
Kailua-Kona, Hawaii 96740

The harbor does not provide a parking lot for guest.

DO NOT PARK IN THE TRAILER STALLS - YOU WILL BE TOWED / TICKETED.

FREE PARKING, ON THE SIDE OF THE STREET IS AVAILABLE…!

ALSO LIMITED FREE PARKING SPACES IN THE BEACH PARKING LOT BY THE OUTRIGGER HOTEL.

data.faqs:
Frequently Asked Questions
What if we don’t see manta rays?
Guests who booked directly with us are covered under our Manta Guarantee, which allows for a complimentary rebooking based on availability. Rebooking may be requested no more than one hour prior to the desired tour.
Please note: Groupon tickets are not eligible for complimentary rebooking unless the optional Manta Guarantee policy was purchased at the time of check-in.

Are wetsuits required?
No. Wetsuits are optional but highly recommended due to cooler ocean temperatures. They are available for rent at the check-in location.

Are lifejackets required?
Lifejackets are not mandatory, but they are available for rent at check-in for guests who would feel more comfortable using one during the tour.

How late can the tour run?
Please note that tour duration is approximate and subject to change.
Delays of up to an hour or more may occur due to wildlife movement, ocean conditions, boat traffic, and other factors. This is normal for open-ocean wildlife tours and applies to all operators.

Can you get injured / harmed?
Yes it’s a Wildlife activity in the Ocean & Boat.

UNDERSTAND THAT THERE ARE INHERENT RISKS INVOLVED WITH SNORKELING AND BOATING, included but not limited to equipment failure, perils of the sea, harm caused by marine creatures including bites & stings, acts of fellow participants, entering and exiting the water, boarding or disembarking boats, and activities on the docks and I HEREBY ASSUME SUCH RISKS. There is no refunds if this listed above occurs.
